nav.tag: A little secret. A lovely surprise.

hero.title: The secret is
hero.description: Bring your favourite people together. We bring the luck; you bring the magic of giving.
hero.badge: No sign-ups · By email · In private
hero.note: For the group that always has something to celebrate.

form.title: Set up your Secret Santa
form.description: One group, one draw and a secret for everyone.
form.name: Participant name
form.empty: It all starts with your people. Add at least 3 participants.
form.limit: 3 to 30 people. Use different names or add a surname.
form.duplicate: That name is already in the group. Add a surname to tell them apart.
form.invalidName: Enter a name between 1 and 40 characters.
form.full: The group can have up to 30 people.
form.explanation: Exclusions work in both directions. Nobody can draw themselves.
form.minimum: Add at least 3 people to get started.
form.impossible: These exclusions make a complete draw impossible. Remove a pair and try again.
form.privacy: Names and emails are sent to the server and email provider to deliver each result privately.
form.storage: Your session could not be restored or saved. You can play, but reloading may lose your changes.
form.duplicateEmail: This email is already in the group. Use a different address for each person.
form.sendError: Some emails could not be sent. Retry to continue the same draw and skip confirmed sends.
form.unavailable: Email sending is not configured yet. Contact the website administrator.
form.expired: The retry window has expired. Contact the website administrator before starting another draw.
form.uncertain: We cannot confirm one of the sends. If it just started, wait and check again using the button. If this persists, contact the organizer to review Gmail before resending.

results.title: Your secrets are on their way
results.description: Each participant receives their result by email in the language selected on the website.
results.dialogDescription: Make sure nobody else is looking before opening your gift.
results.secret: Keep it secret. Time to find that perfect gift!
results.confirmText: The group, exclusions and all results will be deleted from this tab.
results.notice: Check your inbox and spam folder. Acceptance for sending does not guarantee delivery.

how.title: Three steps. So many smiles.
how.subtitle: A simple little plan to make someone’s day.

steps.title: Gather your people

steps.text: Set exclusions and draw names. Nobody gets themselves.

steps.title: Reveal and surprise
steps.text: Receive your result by email and find a thoughtful gift.
